rule: Claim-specific state; software, reproduction, mechanism, external validation, production and publication are distinct.
frozen_outcome_rule: Negative, mixed and falsified outcomes are immutable. Changed question, mechanism, data role, threshold or confirmatory protocol creates a versioned successor rather than rescuing the original claim.

freeze_contracts.question: Under the frozen ARC-Challenge train/validation protocol, does tested LAM-JEPA outperform a matched supervised control and do planner/target pathways contribute under predeclared criteria?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: The full system will outperform the matched supervised control and show positive planner and target contributions.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: JEPA-style latent prediction with project-specific latent-action/planner/target pathways; component contribution is isolated with no-planner/no-target controls.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Architecture is primarily a combination of established JEPA/latent-action/planning directions; current defensible research value is the reproducible negative/falsification package, not a validated new mechanism.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: Frozen validation evidence reproducibly does not support superiority, planner benefit or target benefit.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: Matched supervised or ablated controls match/exceed the full system or component effects fail frozen positive criteria.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: paper provenance/figures + independent review; no new ARC science

freeze_contracts.question: At controlled false-open behavior, can an online estimator adapt to persistent regime change faster and with lower transition/post-change error than strong robust detector-plus-estimator systems without sacrificing isolated-corruption or clean performance?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: Further IRIS science is justified only if a frozen method beats the simple robust baseline frontier on recovery/transition/post-change error at comparable false-open behavior.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: Scientific object is the robustness-adaptation tradeoff separating persistent state change from isolated heavy-tailed corruption; no new successor architecture is currently authorized.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Robust changepoint detection under outliers/heavy tails is established; contribution requires an estimator-level frontier or residual failure not solved by simple robust detector+estimator systems.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: Current v0.2/PABIM line fails its development promotion gate; simple robust baseline confounds remain unresolved.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: Simple robust detector+estimator systems match or dominate the practical false-open/recovery/post-change frontier.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: freeze development-only baseline-frontier protocol; confirmatory seeds remain quarantined

freeze_contracts.question: Under matched task graphs and provider/resource budgets, does evidence-native orchestration reduce lost work, duplicate execution, unverifiable completion and recovery time after faults relative to a competent durable orchestrator?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: Evidence/claim gating plus durable lease/recovery semantics improves correctness/recovery without merely serializing work or hiding throughput cost.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: Durable task/lease state, evidence-gated transitions, provenance, deduplication and crash recovery.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Queues, DAGs, leases, hashes and provider routing are established; research novelty is deferred pending a precise measured systems effect.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: Only bounded design/control evidence is supported; real host state/performance is unknown here.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: A competent simpler orchestrator matches correctness/recovery at equal workload/concurrency or apparent reliability gain disappears after controlling for reduced concurrency.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: non-destructive real Mac SQLite/WAL/process/lease/heartbeat recovery, then bounded fault matrix

freeze_contracts.question: After validation is matched, does any structured/typed representation advantage survive on genuinely new part families and compositional prompts versus competent contemporary direct/program generation?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: A representation-specific benefit is only supported if the structured route retains a material execution/semantic advantage after validation, backend/provider and budget are matched on a new frozen benchmark.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: Validation is already demonstrated as the dominant cause of the old reused-diagnostic gap; remaining representation mechanism is unproven.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Text-to-CAD, parametric programs, typed IR and validation are established; current strong value is engineering reliability, not a demonstrated new CAD representation mechanism.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: Typed-parser-specific causal advantage is falsified on the reused diagnostic; software reliability remains useful.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: Matched direct/program generation closes the gap on a genuinely new frozen benchmark, or no fair new benchmark can be defined.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: only a genuinely new benchmark freeze; no same-case rescue

freeze_contracts.question: Does the reduced-resistance representation retain its pressure-MAE advantage against matched learned operator/surrogate baselines and held-out physical regimes?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: The mechanism remains materially better at matched compute/capacity under held-out/OOD or misaligned fields.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: Reduced-resistance representation in the current synthetic Darcy screen.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Current evidence is a bounded synthetic mechanism result, not learned neural-operator superiority or real porous-media generalization.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: The frozen synthetic screen shows a large reproducible pressure-MAE improvement with retained flux check.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: Matched learned/simple reduced-order baseline matches the gain or effect disappears on held-out/OOD regimes.

freeze_contracts.question: Is any adverse-condition memory gain specific to the proposed learned non-Gaussian mechanism rather than generic robust aggregation or standard/reference memory?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: A learned non-Gaussian arm should clear predeclared adverse gates over standard/reference memory at equal capacity without unacceptable clean regression.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: Precursor isolates robust-readout effects; NGMT v0.1 separately tests equal-budget learned B0/B1/B2/B3 arms.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Robust readouts/memory controls are established; current unique learned mechanism claim is unsupported.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: Precursor is non-unique and NGMT v0.1 misses both adverse superiority gates.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: Robust controls explain the effect or B3 fails frozen B1/B2 gates.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: negative-result package; redesign only as a new version

freeze_contracts.question: Is APEN's rare-event benefit specifically caused by correctly aligned temporal salience and does it persist beyond generic learned memory under realistic salience degradation?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: Correct alignment beats uniform memory, shuffled/random salience erases the gain, and matched learned memory does not fully explain the effect.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: Salience-weighted memory prioritizes temporally aligned rare-event information.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Attention/memory weighting and salience heuristics are established; current evidence supports only bounded alignment specificity in a synthetic task.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: Correct salience alignment matters in the current synthetic task; randomization erases the measured rare-event gain.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: Matched learned memory explains the effect or realistic salience corruption removes practical benefit.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: freeze one learned-control + naturalistic salience-quality stress protocol only if it outranks closure tasks

freeze_contracts.question: Does the eigen/spectral representation improve the frozen primary covariance-matrix forecasting target over strong classical raw/log/PCA/spectral baselines?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: Eigen-JEPA should beat the strongest frozen baseline on primary covariance-matrix MSE.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: Eigen/spectral representation of covariance dynamics compared with raw/log/PCA and spectral ridge controls.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Spectral decomposition/ridge/PCA are established; current method has not established mechanism or empirical superiority.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: Strong classical baselines match or beat the method on the frozen primary metric.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: Any competent frozen baseline matches or improves primary covariance-matrix MSE.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: reconcile row-count provenance and convert negative/mixed result; any multi-dataset extension is a new freeze

freeze_contracts.question: Do NPMS features contain useful causal/natural-task information beyond coordinate-invariant parameter summaries and competent learned memory controls?
freeze_contracts.hypothesis: If unique, NPMS should clear the frozen uniqueness margin and retain value on natural/OOD tasks beyond invariant parameter summaries.
freeze_contracts.mechanism: Controlled spectral/memory features with coordinate-invariance diagnostics.
freeze_contracts.novelty_boundary: Broad regime-classification uniqueness is weakened by a strong invariant-parameter control; coordinate-invariance evidence remains bounded.
freeze_contracts.primary_claim: NPMS 92.86% versus invariant-parameter 89.29% fails the frozen 5-point uniqueness gate.
freeze_contracts.falsifier: Invariant parameter summaries or matched learned controls explain the effect, or natural/OOD transfer fails.
freeze_contracts.next_gate: natural/causal task only if it outranks current closure work
